profile.primaryRole: Senior digital transformation and product leader at the intersection of healthcare and technology
profile.summary: Geetanjali is a seasoned digital transformation and product executive with 17+ years of experience spanning healthcare IT, SaaS product management, and enterprise program leadership. She has driven large-scale agile transformations, launched direct-to-consumer digital platforms, and built governance frameworks across multi-million-dollar portfolios at companies like Pfizer and Bio Reference Laboratories. Her sweet spot is translating complex business strategy into executable product and technology roadmaps in health-tech and life-sciences environments.
